IRAN NUCLEAR DEAL ODDS COLLAPSE

Prediction markets are turning sharply more skeptical on a U.S.-Iran nuclear deal.

Kalshi now prices the odds at just 13% by March 2027, 16% by January 2028, and 15% by January 2029 — all falling sharply in recent weeks.
